name: Crater Lake National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets may use a few trails and plowed roads, but not Cleetwood Cove Trail or the lake.
summary: Leashed pets may use a few trails and plowed roads, but not Cleetwood Cove Trail or the lake.

excerpts.quote: Hikers may only be in possession of one leashed pet per person on trails.
Pets must be leashed and in physical control of the hiker at all times.
All hiking and designated ski trails/routes except for those listed above.

dogRules.text: One leashed pet per hiker on trails.
Trails open to pets: Lady of the Woods, Godfrey Glen, Annie Spur, Grayback Drive and the Pacific Crest Trail; all other trails are closed.
No pets on Cleetwood Cove Trail, even carried.
No pets in Crater Lake or any stream or water.
Not in visitor centers, the lodge or other public buildings.
